Universal LPC Spritesheet Character Generator: character art (Liberated Pixel Cup)
https://github.com/LiberatedPixelCup/Universal-LPC-Spritesheet-Character-Generator
Commit 04140673ec02906f8233523639733c83690df750 (2026-11-11)

Only artwork is copied here, unmodified, from the repository's spritesheets/ folder, with
the same paths. The repository's code is GPL-3.0 and none of it is used.

Every file has its own authors and licences: see CREDITS.csv in this folder (the rows of
the repository's CREDITS.csv for exactly these files). Each file lists one or more of the
licences below; the repository's README says each image "is licensed under one or more of
the following" and that following every term of CC-BY-SA lets you use all of its art.
Neque's Realm uses these files under the licence picked per file in assets/CREDITS.md:
OGA-BY 3.0 when the file lists it, else CC-BY-SA 3.0. Never under GPL only (no file here
lists GPL alone). Sprites composed from them (layers drawn together and recoloured by
tools/spritepack from assets/sprites.yaml `animations`) are CC-BY-SA 3.0 works derived
from these files.

Licences (their full text is at these addresses):
- Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 3.0 Unported (CC-BY-SA 3.0)
  https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/legalcode
- OpenGameArt.org Attribution 3.0 (OGA-BY 3.0)
  https://static.opengameart.org/OGA-BY-3.0.txt
- Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported (CC-BY 3.0)
  https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/legalcode
- GNU General Public License 2.0 / 3.0 (listed as an alternative by some files; not used)
  https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-3.0.txt

Attribution: the authors of each file are in CREDITS.csv (columns "authors" and "urls").
